title: Minor Heat Solar Term
prompt: Describe the significance of the Minor Heat solar term in the traditional Chinese calendar.
hint: Explain its timing, weather characteristics, and cultural customs associated with it.
sample: Minor Heat is the 11th solar term marking the hottest period of the year with high temperatures and humidity. In southern China, people celebrate by tasting freshly harvested rice, while in northern China, eating dumplings is common to stimulate appetite during the heat.

ja.prompt: 伝統的な中国の暦における小暑の重要性について説明してください。
ja.hint: 小暑の時期、気候の特徴、そしてそれに関連する文化的な習慣について述べてください。
ja.sample: 小暑は伝統的な中国の暦で11番目の節気で、一年で最も暑い時期の到来を示します。南部では新米を味わう習慣があり、北部では夏の食欲減退を補うために餃子を食べる風習があります。

zh.prompt: 描述傳統中國曆法中小暑節氣的意義。
zh.hint: 說明其時間、天氣特徵及相關的文化習俗。
zh.sample: 小暑是傳統中國曆法中的第11個節氣，標誌著一年中最熱的時期，氣溫高且濕度大。中國南方人會品嚐新收割的稻米，而北方則有吃餃子以刺激食慾的習俗。

title: Cultural Customs of Minor Heat
prompt: Explain the different cultural customs observed during Minor Heat in southern and northern China.
hint: Mention the tradition of 'shushin' in the south and the dumpling-eating custom in the north.
sample: In southern China, the folk tradition called 'shushin' involves tasting freshly harvested rice and newly brewed tea. In northern China, people eat dumplings to help revive their appetite during the hot summer days.

ja.prompt: 小暑の時期に中国南部と北部で行われる異なる文化的習慣について説明してください。
ja.hint: 南部の「暑新」という伝統と北部の餃子を食べる習慣について述べてください。
ja.sample: 中国南部では「暑新」と呼ばれる新米や新しく淹れたお茶を味わう民間の伝統があります。北部では暑さで食欲が落ちる夏に餃子を食べて食欲を回復させる習慣があります。

title: Nature and Atmosphere during Minor Heat
prompt: Describe the natural phenomena and atmosphere during the Minor Heat period.
hint: Include details about weather, lotus flowers blooming, cicadas singing, and the vitality of life.
sample: During Minor Heat, the weather is blistering hot with relentless heat waves. Lotus flowers bloom vibrantly, and cicadas fill the air with their chorus, symbolizing the unyielding vitality of life in late summer.
